# docs/templates

Copy a template, then fill every field. The minimum fields come from `docs/TASKS.md` Appendix B.

| Template | Copy to |
|---|---|
| `plan.md` | `docs/tasks/Txx/plan.md` |
| `review.md` | `docs/tasks/Txx/review.md` |
| `test-cases.md` | `docs/tests/Txx/test-cases.md` |
| `test-report.md` | `docs/tests/Txx/test-report.md` |
| `defect.md` | A new entry in `docs/tests/defects.md` |
| `adr.md` | `docs/adr/ADR-000x-title.md` |
| `runbook.md` | `docs/runbooks/name.md` |
